title: Mystery Artist: Water Lilies
content: Can you name the artist who painted these water lilies? I'll send a deluxe Dinotopia map to the first person who guesses the correct answer.-----Addendum:Zelascorrectly identified the Russian painter Isaac Levitan (1860-1900). The painting is 95cm x 128cm and was painted in 1895, before Claude Monet's famous water lily paintings.More samples of Levitan atAthaeneum.org/LevitanandWikipedia/Levitan
